replies.author: OldManTigerMask
replies.body:
Camel is actually is a very unique map and I think has excellent gameplay, nothing seems to be wrong with it.

Also following up the wool respawn, it's just an XML issue. Tell a map dev.

Following up with, 
No good drops - Kill Rewards are almost here
No good pick axe - Simply ask a Map Dev to fix it.

There is nothing wrong with the aesthetics or the overall gameplay, so there is no reason to delete it if it can all be fixed easily.
